1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de copa baja y ancha, hojas de color verde plateado, flores en forma de campana, pequeñas y de color amarillo, y baya azul oscuro con grandes semillas de color castaño; del tronco y las ramas se extrae una savia lechosa. Sapotaceae, Micropholis chrysophylloides.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree with a low and broad canopy, leaves of silver-green color, bell-shaped flowers that are small and yellow in color, and dark blue berries with large brown seeds; a milky sap is extracted from the trunk and branches. Sapotaceae, Micropholis chrysophylloides.
